name: agentic-hq-e2e-test-string-reversal-copy
// DYNAMIC-LINK-PATH: The agentic-hq dependency uses link: protocol. The placeholder REPO_ROOT_PLACEHOLDER is replaced at test runtime with the real absolute path to the agentic-hq repo root.

scripts.// POSTINSTALL: FIX: node-pty posix_spawnp failed. pnpm extracts spawn-helper without +x. Same fix as main project. See: https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/issues/7366

// EXACT-PINS-AHQ-152: tsx and commander are pinned to EXACT versions (no ^ range) as a deliberate supply-chain WORKAROUND for not being able to freeze this fixture. Everywhere else in the repo we use the frozen-lockfile control (AHQ-152), but it CANNOT be used here: the e2e harness copies this fixture to a temp dir and rewrites the agentic-hq link: path at runtime, and pnpm records link: deps in pnpm-lock.yaml as a DEPTH-RELATIVE path — so a committed lockfile produces a DANGLING agentic-hq symlink at the new depth (verified empirically). Exact pins give the same 'no silent version drift' protection for the only two third-party registry deps, with no lockfile required. agentic-hq itself is first-party (local link) and carries no supply-chain risk, so it needs no pin. When intentionally bumping these, update both versions here. See AHQ-152.
